verdict.rationale: Notion's homepage directly claims the story's exact capability: "Get answers, instantly—with citations." Supporting docs show AI chat with agents through sessions and AI search across Notion content and connected sources. The core claim is a one-line marketing statement without in-depth documentation. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on how citations link back to workspace pages, documented scope and permissions for answers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality and citation accuracy.
